submitted.rationale: EQE decreases steadily as the Sb fraction rises: 0.343% (Sb 0.220), 0.287% (0.236), 0.191% (0.303), 0.031% (0.654), 0.027% (0.800). XRD of indices 0 and 4 shows the same phase, so there is no phase boundary between them. The lowest-Sb end of the line (index 0) gives the highest EQE.
